the interdigitated metal structure with a 50-μm-wide finger and 10-μm-wide gap is the most suitable electrode design for the fabrication of photodetectors with a high responsivity.

the photodetector performance can be optimized by choosing the appropriate electrode geometry and by controlling the environmental conditions during operation.

interdigitated electrodes with a large number of fingers and narrow finger width can be used to improve the photodetector response.
